notes.title: New Update - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey all,

I've gone ahead and released a small update that fixes the bugs that have been thus far reported by players.  Of note, the disappearing cursor bug should not be resolved.  Please let me know if you still have this issue!

Also, based on player feedback, I've included a bit of extra direction at a certain point in the game, when the player must get an item in a certain room in order to proceed.  No more wandering aimlessly in the corridors unsure of what to do next!

Enjoy, everyone!
